title: Kyber-Weave edit hook configuration
description: Settings for .kyber-weave/hooks.yml. Everything is optional: the file is merged over the built-in C# rules.

time-budget-seconds.description: Total seconds the hook may spend running commands for one edit. Default 30.

stop-on-first-blocking.description: Stop after the first blocking failure instead of running every rule. Default false.

max-output-lines.description: Most output lines kept per failing rule in the feedback. Default 30.

max-output-bytes.description: Most output bytes kept per failing rule in the feedback. Default 3000.

rules.description: Rule overrides. A rule with a built-in id changes only the fields it sets. This repository file cannot add a rule that names a command: a new rule belongs in the user file, ~/.kyber-weave/hooks.yml.

id.description: Rule name. Built-in ids: dotnet-format-whitespace, dotnet-format-style, dotnet-test.

kind.description: lint rules run before test rules.

include.description: Globs over the repository-relative path (** crosses folders, * and ? do not).

exclude.description: Globs that remove a path from the rule.

run.description: Command as an argument list, never a shell string. Refused for an id that is not built in, because a repository may not name a command. Tokens: {file}, {root}, {marker}, {project}, {target} (project, else marker), {testProject}, and a standalone {testClasses}.

timeout-seconds.description: Longest the command may run. Default 25.

blocking.description: Whether a failure makes the hook exit 2 so the agent sees it. Default true.

enabled.description: Set false to turn a rule off, true to turn on an opt-in rule such as dotnet-test.
